attribution.localizedCause: Production FF2 transpose arithmetic maps SIMD lanes to adjacent output features, accumulates each ordered 128-feature reduction panel from zero, and combines completed panels into the prior output before the final BF16 conversion. The missing panel boundary caused both earlier mismatch populations.

decision.rationale: Install the uniform 128-panel transpose into the complete open top-FF1 backward candidate, preserve the captured source adjoint as an independent regression, and rerun the retained ff_bias1_19 gate before changing GEGLU arithmetic.

hypothesis.rationale: The ordered 128-feature panel reset-and-combine treatment reproduces all 6,291,456 source FF2-input-adjoint BF16 words with zero maximum error.

transferableLessons: Exact LibNC matmul replay requires both the selected lane kernel and its driver-level reduction panel schedule; kernel-loop order alone is not the full numerical contract.
uncertainties: GEGLU branch-product and GELU-derivative parity remain untested after installing the now-exact FF2 transpose.

reasons: The prospectively frozen 128-panel evaluator completed two full 6,291,456-word treatment populations byte-identically, preserved the 775-word horizontal and 929-word unblocked-lane control mismatches, changed both controls, bound the LibNC and parameter digests, validated strict outputs, and passed source, memory, scratch, and cleanup guards.
